name: Dead Beat Dads
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of fathers in guiding and nurturing their children, showing that a wise son brings joy to his father while foolishness brings sorrow to his mother. Fathers are called to actively train and correct their children in the way they should go, ensuring discipline is administered with love and wisdom. Disrespect toward parents is sternly warned against, highlighting the serious consequences of such behavior. Walking in the Spirit empowers believers to overcome fleshly desires, enabling fathers to fulfill their God-given responsibilities faithfully.
